content: Incorporated in 2012 by Mr. Kamal Agrawal, a core finance professional, we started with a vision to create innovative IT solutions for selective target segments.

While we began with IT outsourcing, today Efficacious focuses on creating complete ERP solutions for schools and education institutes. Our mission is to revolutionize school operations with Child Security as the prime focus.

data.title: Sales & Business Development
data.description:
About the Role:
We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and self-motivated Business Development Executive to drive sales and acquire new clients for our software products and IT solutions.
Our product portfolio includes E-Smart School Management Software, E-Smart Health Management Software, E-Smart Queue Management System, and E-Smart Restaurant Management Software, along with their respective mobile applications.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating business leads, conducting product demonstrations, building client relationships, and converting prospects into long-term customers.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Identify and generate new business opportunities across relevant industries.
  • Research and approach potential clients, including schools, colleges, hospitals, clinics, restaurants, and other businesses.
  • Generate leads through cold calling, email marketing, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other channels.
  • Understand client requirements and recommend suitable software solutions.
  • Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and presentations for prospective clients.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers.
  • Prepare sales proposals, quotations, and presentations in coordination with the concerned team.
  • Follow up with potential clients, negotiate commercial terms, and close sales deals.
  • Maintain an updated database of leads, prospects, meetings, and sales activities in the CRM or reporting system.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly lead generation, client acquisition, and revenue targets.
  • Coordinate with the technical and implementation teams to ensure a smooth customer onboarding process.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback to identify new business opportunities.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, IT, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, or IT/software sales is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and convincing skills.
  • Experience in lead generation, prospecting, and client acquisition.
  • Basic understanding of software products, web applications, and mobile applications.
  • Ability to understand customer requirements and present suitable solutions.
  • Good relationship-building and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, email communication, and online business tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience selling software products, SaaS solutions, or IT services.
  • Experience in selling software to educational institutions, healthcare organizations, restaurants, or other businesses.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools, LinkedIn prospecting, and digital lead-generation techniques.
  • A proven track record of acquiring new clients and closing B2B sales.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:
  • Number of qualified leads generated.
  • Number of client meetings and product demonstrations conducted.
  • Number of new clients acquired.
  • Conversion rate from leads to paying customers.
  • Monthly and quarterly sales revenue achieved.
  • Quality of client relationships and follow-up activities.

Ideal Candidate:
The ideal candidate should be proactive, confident, persuasive, and passionate about sales. They should have a strong business mindset, the ability to communicate with decision-makers, and the motivation to generate new business opportunities for our software products.

Work Location: In person

Job Description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Back Office Executive to handle day-to-day administrative work, data entry, documentation, and basic accounting-related activities. Candidates with knowledge of Tally and basic accounting will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform daily data entry and maintain accurate records.
  • Handle invoices, bills, vouchers, and other business documents.
  • Maintain and update Excel sheets, reports, and databases.
  • Assist with basic accounting and financial record-keeping.
  • Manage filing, documentation, and office administration.
  • Coordinate with internal departments for routine office tasks.
  • Maintain records of sales, purchases, payments, and receipts.

Required Skills:
  • Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and MS Word.
  • Good typing speed and attention to detail.
  • Good communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to maintain records accurately and meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of Tally is an added advantage.
  • Basic accounting knowledge will be preferred.

Eligibility
  • Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
  • Candidates with Tally knowledge and accounting experience will be given preference.

Education:
  • Bachelor's (Preferred)
